MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of marine and freshwater environments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and climatic conditions in marine and Freshwater and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fishery by-products and their industrial uses 4.0 Marine Operations and Blue Eco and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
